rules.rule: accessibility.json
Never render AI output that a reasonable user would mistake for human-authored or system-authoritative content.
An aiBehavior of Apply or Approve must never fire without a human gesture. Auto-apply on render is forbidden.
Do not render a confidence value the model did not produce. Absence of confidence is shown as absent, not as high.
When requiresReview is true the primary action must be reachable only after the review signal has been displayed.
No more than three visible actions in one ai:ai-action row. A fourth belongs in an overflow menu.
A thinking or working indicator must reflect real in-flight work. Never animate to simulate effort.
AI tokens (--ai-*) and ai:* components do not appear on standard product surfaces.
When an AI action fails, say what failed and what the human can do. Never fail silently or retry invisibly.
destructive-action
form-submit
empty-state
ai-approval-flow
ai-response
agent-read-flow
No component, pattern, or layout not listed in components/COMPONENTS_INDEX.json
No imports outside @/components/ui/*, @/components/ai/*, @/components/patterns/*, @/components/layout/*, @/lib/*, @/hooks/*
No external UI libraries (Material UI, Ant Design, Chakra, Mantine, Bootstrap) without explicit approval and indexing
No raw custom markup when an indexed component covers the need
No edits to src/components/ui/* without an explicit task requirement
No hard-coded hex, rgb, or hsl values in component classes where a semantic Tailwind token exists (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border, ...)
No npm installs, package.json edits, bundler changes, or new build tooling initiated by an agent
No interactive control without keyboard operation and a visible focus-visible ring
No status, error, or state communicated by color alone
No body copy below 14px; prefer 16px
No interactive target below 44x44px effective hit area
No modal or dialog for a primary multi-step workflow that belongs on a full page
No critical-only information inside ui:tooltip or ui:hover-card
No ai:* component on a surface that is not AI-generated or agent-driven
No AI-generated content rendered without attribution, and no ai:* action with aiBehavior of Apply or Approve rendered without an accountability affordance
